description: Historical matched RTX3090 measurements: two native CUDA schedules and the PR #308 Futhark temporal reference. The reference implementation/tooling has been removed from this branch; these numbers retain the measured algorithm baseline.

method.aggregation: physical cell count times full timesteps / median of ten execution times; round ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals

validation_commands: python -m pytest tests/hardware/test_cuda_backends.py -x -q -k 'extended_feature_envelope or matches_jax_complete_state or fused_workspace_and_tails or continuation_preserves_absolute_dft_clock or source_graph_continues'
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck --report-api-errors no --error-exitcode 99 python -m pytest tests/hardware/test_cuda_mstep.py -k 'complete_state and (binary-all-2 or binary-right-3)' -x -q

compute-sanitizer --tool racecheck --report-api-errors no --kernel-name kns=MstepPackedColumnCore --racecheck-num-workers 4 --launch-count 1 --error-exitcode 99 python -m pytest tests/hardware/test_cuda_mstep.py -k short_column_sanitizer -x -q
